project.name: KillingCard
project.concept: Killstreak's lane card battler rebuilt on vertical columns, where every card is a wide calling-card banner: the art decides whether it's a unit or a tactic, and many arts share one gameplay card.
project.based_on: killstreak (copied source; Killstreak and CallingCard stay untouched as backups)

development_rules: Calling cards finally get a purpose: every banner you collect is a playable card, with shared gameplay and alternate art.

risks.mitigation: Strict feature freeze after design phase
